title: A/R Detail: credit memos and deposits are plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a customer with an unused credit memo A and an unused deposit A at your current location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with that customer ticked and every bucket expanded.
custom_steps:
1. Hover over credit memo A's number.
  2. Click it.
  3. Hover over deposit A's number.
  4. Click it.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Credit memo A's number is plain text, not a link.

Step 2:

  • Nothing opens: a credit memo has no page of its own.

Step 3:

  • Deposit A's number is plain text, not a link.

Step 4:

  • Nothing opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R10: “A/R credit memos and deposits show as plain text: they have no page of their own.”
  • Out of Scope: “Links for A/R credit memos and deposits. They have no page of their own to open, so they stay plain text.”
